subject: ONE chubby golden hamster in a knitted vest and a tiny jeweller's loupe on one eye, cheeks that balloon and empty, bounding sideways all the time
second_characters: ONE grim utility mole in an orange hard hat who stomps after the hamster slapping bills; TWO sparrows

props.big: ONE glass jewellery display case full of buckwheat grains instead of diamonds; ONE old iron radiator with a tin funnel on top; long paper utility bills

environment: a cramped bright pantry packed with jars, sacks, shelves of buckwheat and strings of onions, frost on a big window, no empty wall
lighting: bright white winter daylight flooding from the big window, frosty blue on the glass
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hamster fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, face never under a quarter of it. He bounds sideways along the shelves and the case in EVERY beat, speech beats too. Bills, sparrows and grains tear across the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat. The camera tracks sideways with him, close, new shot size every beat. Nothing hangs between him and the lens.

audio.delivery: plump earnest male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 6.60, then the mole and the radiator carry it
audio.lip_sync: the hamster himself speaks, mouth opening on every syllable, brows and jaw alive
audio.pronunciation: se-VOD-nya GRECH-ka da-STOY-na-ye vlo-ZHE-ni-ye. LISH by kha-TI-la PO-sle o-PLA-ty SCHO-tov za TEP-lo

timeline.a: chest-up, from the very first frame the hamster bounds sideways along the buckwheat case staring through his loupe at ONE grain pinched up to it, the window sun makes it flash star glints like a cut diamond, eyes wide, grains spraying across the lens
the hamster scoops both pawfuls and crams them into his cheeks mid-hop, cheeks ballooning round, grains spraying across the lens

timeline.line: Лишь бы хватило после оплаты счетов за тепло.
timeline.a: waist-up, facing the lens, mouth wide and clear on every syllable despite round cheeks, he snatches a long bill from the stomping mole and bounds sideways along the shelf, the bill unrolling across the frame, bills raining across the lens
the mole rams his open paw under the hamster's chin and the hamster spits his whole cheekful of grains into it, grains spraying across the lens
the mole slams the grains into the funnel on top of the radiator and it clanks and hisses, sparrows bursting across the lens
the hamster leaps onto the warm radiator and hugs it with all four paws, cheeks flat and empty, steam whipping across the lens
the mole slaps one more bill onto the radiator and the hamster bounces off it sideways, grains spraying across the lens
the hamster swings his face to the lens with a flat stare, cheeks empty, ONE last grain rolling off his loupe

must_appear: 0.00 the hamster staring through his loupe at ONE buckwheat grain that sparkles like a diamond; 6.60 he spits his cheekful into the mole hand; 9.35 empty cheeks on the radiator, flat stare
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a horizontal 16:9 picture, letterbox, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a conveyor belt, a cart, a parked camera, standing in place, wide shot, night, dark scene, a hero back to the camera, a closed mouth while speaking, a paw over his mouth,a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 6.60, English speech, real diamonds, a second hamster, rice, duplicate props, a second mole, foreign accent
